# hush_github_app_access_credential (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about a GitHub App access credential in the Hush Security platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hush_github_app_access_credential" "example" {
  id = "acr-eu12345678"
}

output "installation_id" {
  value = data.hush_github_app_access_credential.example.installation_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the GitHub App access credential

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The GitHub App's client ID, shown on its settings page: 1-64 letters, digits and dots. Older `Iv1.<hex>` client IDs are accepted, as is the numeric App ID
- `deployment_ids` (List of String) List of deployment IDs that can access this credential. Currently limited to a single deployment
- `description` (String) The description of the GitHub App access credential
- `installation_id` (String) The ID of the App's installation on the account whose repositories the tokens reach: a positive integer of at most 19 digits, without leading zeros
- `kind` (String) The kind of access credential
- `name` (String) The name of the GitHub App access credential
- `secret_store_id` (String) The ID of the secret store where this credential is saved (optional)
- `type` (String) The type of access credential
